title: Paul di Resta was in the No. 853 race, what percent faster did he finish in
question:
Paul di Resta was in the No. 853 race, what percent faster did he finish in the 853rd race than the next race for the fastest lap speed?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Paul di Resta refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename ='Paul' and drivers.surname = 'di Resta'; race number refers to raceId; percentage = DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(fastestLapSpeed(raceId = 853), (fastestLapSpeed (raceId = 854)) * 100 , (fastestLapSpeed(raceId = 853))

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH race_853 AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_065 AS race_id,
        r.XCL_067 AS round,
        r.XCL_070 AS race_date,
        res.XCL_082 AS fastest_lap_speed
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
    JOIN drivers d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    WHERE r.XCL_067 = 853
      AND d.XCL_035 = 'Paul'
      AND d.XCL_038 = 'di Resta'
),
next_race AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_065 AS race_id,
        r.XCL_067 AS round,
        r.XCL_070 AS race_date,
        res.XCL_082 AS fastest_lap_speed
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
    JOIN drivers d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    WHERE r.XCL_067 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_067) FROM races WHERE XCL_067 > 853)
      AND d.XCL_035 = 'Paul'
      AND d.XCL_038 = 'di Resta'
)
SELECT 
    (nr.fastest_lap_speed - r853.fastest_lap_speed) * 100.0 / r853.fastest_lap_speed AS percent_faster
FROM race_853 r853
JOIN next_race nr ON 1=1
